title: Desk bridge v0: catalog
description: What a view, or the brain writing one, can use on this desk: the view components, the connected connectors with the kinds and fields of their items, and the commands the caller may invoke. It needs no scope: it shows only what the caller's data:read and cmd:invoke grants cover.

CatalogGetRequest.description: Describe what the caller can bind, show and run.

components.description: The view components the desk renders.

connectors.description: The connectors with at least one instance, by id, with only the kinds the caller's data:read grants cover; a connector with none of them is left out.

commands.description: The registered commands the caller's cmd:invoke grants cover, in registration order.

CatalogConnector.description: A connected connector: its instances and the kinds of item it brings in.

CatalogKind.description: One kind of item a connector brings in, and the fields its items have, which bindings, sorts and templates can name.
